configured_fallback_lines.source_text: Oh, iho, ano ang iyong mga kailangan?

localization.english: Oh, iho, what do you need?
localization.tagalog: Oh, iho, ano'ng kailangan mo?

configured_fallback_lines.source_text: Pasensya na at nagtataas ako ng presyo, nagkakaubusan na kasi ngayon ng [b]supplies[/b].

localization.english: Sorry, iho, prices went up. [b]Supplies[/b] are almost gone.
localization.tagalog: Pasensya na, iho, tumaas na presyo. Paubos na kasi ang [b]supplies[/b].

active_assignments.source_text: Anak kamusta, Narinig mo na ba yung balita?

localization.english: Nak, how are you? Did you hear the news? Knowing you, you probably haven't.
localization.tagalog: Nak, kamusta? Narinig mo na ba yung balita? Naku, baka di mo pa alam.

active_assignments.source_text: May paparating na bagyo ulit... kailangan nating maghanda.

localization.english: Another storm's coming, nak. We need to get ready now, no dawdling.
localization.tagalog: May paparating na namang bagyo, nak. Maghanda na tayo, wag nang magpatumpik-tumpik.

active_assignments.source_text: Mas malakas daw ito kaysa dati, kaya kailangan nating maging maingat.

localization.english: They say this one's stronger than the last, so we really have to be careful, okay? Okay, nak?
localization.tagalog: Mas malakas daw 'to kesa dati, kaya mag-ingat tayo, ha? Ha, nak?

active_assignments.source_text: May kailangan tayong bilhin bago lumakas ang bagyo. Ito ang pera, anak.

localization.english: We need to get a few things before the storm gets worse. Here's the money, nak. Don't lose it.
localization.tagalog: May bibilhin tayo bago lumakas ang bagyo. Eto yung pera, nak. Wag mong iwawala 'yan.

active_assignments.source_text: Nasa [b]bodega[/b] ang [b]martilyo[/b], [b]radyo[/b], at [b]flashlight[/b]. Kailangan ng [b]isang baterya bawat isa[/b] ng radyo at flashlight bago ilagay sa [b]istante katabi ni Lola[/b].

localization.english: The [b]hammer[/b], [b]radio[/b], and [b]flashlight[/b] are in the [b]storage room[/b]. The radio and flashlight each need [b]one battery[/b] before you put them on the [b]shelf beside Lola[/b].
localization.tagalog: Nasa [b]bodega[/b] ang [b]martilyo[/b], [b]radyo[/b], at [b]flashlight[/b]. Kailangan ng [b]isang baterya bawat isa[/b] ng radyo at flashlight bago ilagay sa [b]istante katabi ni Lola[/b].

active_assignments.source_text: [i]Inabot ni Nanay ang pera para sa mga kailangang bilhin.[/i] Hindi natin maililigtas lahat, anak. Unahin mo ang pinaka-kailangan.

localization.english: [i]Nanay hands over the money.[/i] We can't save everything, nak. Start with what matters most.
localization.tagalog: [i]Inabot ni Nanay ang pera.[/i] Hindi natin maaayos lahat, nak. Unahin mo yung pinaka-importante.

active_assignments.source_text: Kasya dapat yan kung maingat ka sa pagbili. Mag-ingat ka ha.

localization.english: That should be enough if you don't waste it. Don't go buying random stuff, okay?
localization.tagalog: Dapat kasya na yan kung hindi ka magwawaldas. Wag kang bibili ng kung ano-ano, ha.

active_assignments.source_text: Opo Nay. Hahanapin ko kung ano ang kailangan ihanda.

localization.english: Yes, Nay. I'll look around for what we still need.
localization.tagalog: Opo, 'Nay. Ako nang bahala maghanap ng mga kailangan.

active_assignments.source_text: Pasensya na anak, hindi ko kayang umalis ng bahay dahil wala mag aalaga sa bunso.

localization.english: Sorry, nak. I can't leave, there's no one to watch Bunso.
localization.tagalog: Pasensya na, nak. Di ako makaalis, walang magbabantay kay bunso.

active_assignments.source_text: Ikaw lang maaasahan ko anak. Mag-ingat ka ha, bumalik ka agad.

localization.english: You're the only one I can count on, nak. Be careful, and come straight back. Don't go hanging around anywhere.
localization.tagalog: Ikaw lang maaasahan ko, nak. Ingat ka, ha, tapos bumalik ka agad. Wag kang tatambay kung saan-saan.

active_assignments.source_text: Ako na po bahala nay.

localization.english: I'll handle it, Nay.
localization.tagalog: Ako na po bahala, 'Nay.

active_assignments.source_text: Kamusta anak, nabili mo na ba ang mga kailangan?

localization.english: How are you, nak? Did you get everything? Nothing forgotten?
localization.tagalog: Kamusta, nak, nabili mo na ba lahat? Wala kang nakalimutan?

active_assignments.source_text: Lumalakas na ang hangin anak, mag-ingat ka.

localization.english: The wind's picking up, nak. Oh, be careful out there, okay!
localization.tagalog: Lumalakas na yung hangin, nak. Naku, mag-ingat ka, ha!

active_assignments.source_text: Huwag ka nang lumabas ulit anak. Malapit na ang bagyo, dito ka nalang at para ligtas.

localization.english: Don't go out again, nak! The storm's almost here. Stay in where it's safe. How many times do I have to say it?
localization.tagalog: Wag ka nang lumabas ulit, nak! Malapit na ang bagyo, dito ka na lang para ligtas. Ilang beses ko bang sasabihin?

active_assignments.source_text: Oy apo, halika. Umupo ka muna sandali.

localization.english: Oy, apo, come here. Sit with me for a bit.
localization.tagalog: Oy, apo, halika. Upo ka muna sandali.

active_assignments.source_text: Apo yung bagyong paparating mag-ingat ka ha.

localization.english: Apo, there's a storm coming, ha. Take care.
localization.tagalog: Apo, may bagyong paparating, ha. Mag-ingat ka.

active_assignments.source_text: Opo Lola.

localization.english: Yes, Lola.
localization.tagalog: Opo, Lola.

active_assignments.source_text: Mabuti naman. Pero yung [b]gamot[/b] ko huwag mo kalimutan yung sa [b]botika[/b] ha.

localization.english: That's good. But don't forget my [b]medicine[/b] from the [b]pharmacy[/b], ha.
localization.tagalog: Mabuti naman. Pero yung [b]gamot[/b] ko, wag mong kalimutan yung sa [b]botika[/b], ha.

active_assignments.source_text: Pag walang gamot, mahihirapan ako. Pasensya na apo.

localization.english: Without my medicine, it gets really hard for me, apo. Sorry to be a bother.
localization.tagalog: Naku, apo, pag wala yung gamot ko, hirap talaga ako. Pasensya ka na ha, nakakaabala pa ko sa'yo.

active_assignments.source_text: Kailangan ni Lola ang [b]gamot[/b]. Kailangan ko pumunta ng [b]botika[/b].

localization.english: Lola needs her [b]medicine[/b]. Gotta swing by the [b]pharmacy[/b].
localization.tagalog: Kailangan ni Lola yung [b]gamot[/b] niya. Dadaan muna ko sa [b]botika[/b].

active_assignments.source_text: Sige na apo, pakilagay na lang sa [b]drawer sa higaan[/b] yung aking [b]gamot[/b].

localization.english: Okay, apo, just put my [b]medicine[/b] in the [b]drawer by the bed[/b].
localization.tagalog: Sige na, apo, pakilagay na lang sa [b]drawer sa higaan[/b] yung [b]gamot[/b] ko.

active_assignments.source_text: Yung [b]gamot[/b], huwag mong kalimutan apo. [i]Mahalaga yun sa akin.[/i]

localization.english: My [b]medicine[/b], apo, don't forget it. [i]That one's important to me.[/i]
localization.tagalog: Yung [b]gamot[/b], ha, apo, wag mong kalimutan. [i]Mahalaga yun sa'kin.[/i]

active_assignments.source_text: Pag umulan nang malakas at walang [b]panakip sa kisame[/b]... [i]basa lahat tayo dito.[/i]

localization.english: If it pours and there's still no [b]cover for the ceiling[/b]... [i]we'll all be soaked in here.[/i]
localization.tagalog: Pag lumakas ang ulan at wala pang [b]panakip sa kisame[/b]... [i]basa tayong lahat dito.[/i]

active_assignments.source_text: Sabi ni Nanay, wala tayong [b]pagkain[/b] para bukas. Kailangan kahit [b]de lata[/b].
active_assignments.review_note: Source speaker is Nanay but this is a Lola line reporting what Nanay said; proposed speaker correction to Lola requires later integration approval.

localization.english: Nanay said we've got no [b]food[/b] left for tomorrow. Even just [b]canned goods[/b] would do.
localization.tagalog: Sabi ni Nanay, wala na tayong [b]pagkain[/b] para bukas. Kahit [b]de lata[/b] lang daw.

active_assignments.source_text: Mabuti na. Nandito na tayo. Dasal lang tayo ngayon.

localization.english: Thank goodness. We're all here now. All we can do is pray.
localization.tagalog: Buti na lang. Nandito na tayo. Dasal na lang ngayon.

active_assignments.source_text: Iho, kung may [b]martilyo[/b] ka sana, maayos ko itong istante. Kapag natulungan mo ako, [b]bababaan ko presyo[/b] ko sa'yo.

localization.english: Iho, if you had a [b]hammer[/b], I could fix this shelf. Help me out and I'll [b]lower my prices[/b] for you.
localization.tagalog: Iho, kung may [b]martilyo[/b] ka lang sana, maaayos ko 'tong istante. Pag natulungan mo ko, [b]babawasan ko presyo[/b] ko para sa'yo.

active_assignments.source_text: Ipapahiram mo? Sige, utang na loob ko 'to. Ibababa ko presyo, pero kailangan mo ng [b]pamalit[/b] kung aayusin mo pa bahay n'yo.

localization.english: You'll give it to me? Sure, I owe you one. I'll lower my prices, but you'll need a [b]replacement[/b] if you've still got repairs at home.
localization.tagalog: Ibibigay mo? Sige, utang na loob ko 'to. Babawasan ko presyo, pero maghanap ka muna ng [b]pamalit[/b] kung may aayusin ka pa sa bahay n'yo.

active_assignments.source_text: Salamat, iho. Para sa'yo, mas mababa na presyo.

localization.english: Thanks, iho. For you, it's cheaper now.
localization.tagalog: Salamat, iho. Para sa'yo, mas mababa na presyo.

active_assignments.source_text: Oh, iho, ano ang iyong mga kailangan?

localization.english: Oh, iho, what do you need?
localization.tagalog: Oh, iho, ano'ng kailangan mo?

active_assignments.source_text: Pasensya na at mataas presyo. Kung may [b]martilyo[/b] ka sana para dito sa istante, [b]bababaan ko presyo[/b] ko sa'yo.

localization.english: Sorry, my prices are high. If you had a [b]hammer[/b] for this shelf, I'd [b]lower them[/b] for you.
localization.tagalog: Pasensya na, mataas presyo ko. Kung may [b]martilyo[/b] ka lang sana para sa istante na 'to, [b]babawasan ko para sa'yo[/b].

active_assignments.source_text: Anak, pwede bang makisuyo? Hindi ako makaalis, hinihintay ko pa asawa ko.

localization.english: Nak, can I ask a favor? I can't leave yet, I'm still waiting on my asawa.
localization.tagalog: Nak, pwede bang makisuyo? Di ako makaalis, hinihintay ko pa asawa ko.

active_assignments.source_text: Bilhan mo sana ako ng [b]Half Chicken[/b] sa [b]Go To Chooks[/b], katabi lang ng [b]Botika[/b].

localization.english: Please buy me [b]Half Chicken[/b] from [b]Go To Chooks[/b], right next to the [b]pharmacy[/b].
localization.tagalog: Bilhan mo sana ako ng [b]Half Chicken[/b] sa [b]Go To Chooks[/b], katabi lang ng [b]Botika[/b].

active_assignments.source_text: Eto ang [b]PHP 150[/b] para sa manok. Ikaw na bahala sa sukli. Nagtitiwala akong makakauwi kami na may [b]hapunan[/b].

localization.english: Here is [b]PHP 150[/b] for the chicken. You can keep the change. I trust that my family will have [b]dinner[/b] at home.
localization.tagalog: Eto ang [b]PHP 150[/b] para sa manok. Ikaw na bahala sa sukli. Nagtitiwala akong makakauwi kami na may [b]hapunan[/b].

active_assignments.source_text: Wala pa? Nagtitiwala pa rin ako sa'yo. Ang [b]Half Chicken[/b] ay sa [b]Go To Chooks[/b], katabi ng [b]Botika[/b].

localization.english: Not yet? I still trust you. [b]Half Chicken[/b] is at [b]Go To Chooks[/b], next to the [b]pharmacy[/b].
localization.tagalog: Wala pa? Nagtitiwala pa rin ako sa'yo. Ang [b]Half Chicken[/b] ay sa [b]Go To Chooks[/b], katabi ng [b]Botika[/b].

active_assignments.source_text: Ay, salamat. May extra [b]tarp[/b] ako sa tricycle. Kunin mo. Mas kailangan n'yo 'to sa bahay.

localization.english: Thank you. I have an extra [b]tarp[/b] in my tricycle. Take it. Your family needs it more.
localization.tagalog: Ay, salamat. May extra [b]tarp[/b] ako sa tricycle. Kunin mo. Mas kailangan n'yo 'to sa bahay.

active_assignments.source_text: Naku, puno ang dala mo. Magbawas ka muna para maabot ko sa'yo itong tarp.

localization.english: Oh no, you're carrying too much. Drop something first so I can hand you this tarp.
localization.tagalog: Naku, puno na dala mo. Magbawas ka muna para maabot ko sa'yo 'tong tarp.

active_assignments.source_text: Salamat ulit, anak. Umuwi ka na rin bago tuluyang lumakas ang hangin.

localization.english: Thanks again, nak. Head home too before the wind picks up.
localization.tagalog: Salamat ulit, nak. Umuwi ka na rin bago pa lumakas ang hangin.

active_assignments.source_text: Nag-tape na ako ng bintana. Hindi ko alam kung science o dasal ang gumagana.

localization.english: I taped up my windows. Not sure if it's science or prayer that's working.
localization.tagalog: Nag-tape na ko ng bintana. Di ko alam kung science o dasal ang gumagana.

active_assignments.source_text: Stress ka na rin ba sa bagyo? Yosi muna tayo sa gilid. Sandali lang.

localization.english: Stressed about the storm too, bro? Let's have a smoke on the side. Just a sec.
localization.tagalog: Stress ka na rin ba sa bagyo, pre? Yosi muna tayo sa gilid. Saglit lang.

active_assignments.source_text: Ayos na. Pero lumakas na ulan, ah. Sana sulit yung pahinga.

localization.english: All good. The rain's gotten heavier though. Hope the break was worth it.
localization.tagalog: Ayos na. Pero lumakas na ang ulan, ah. Sana sulit yung pahinga.

active_assignments.source_text: Ano po ang inyong kailangan? Mabuti at naabutan niyo pa ang [b]botika[/b] na bukas.

localization.english: What can I get you? You're lucky you caught the [b]pharmacy[/b] still open.
localization.tagalog: Ano po'ng kailangan nila? Buti naabutan nyo pa ang [b]botika[/b] na bukas.

active_assignments.source_text: Ano pa hinihintay mo iho, bili na ng aming malinamnam na manok!

localization.english: What are you waiting for, iho? Come get our juicy chicken!
localization.tagalog: Ano pang hinihintay mo, iho? Bili na ng masarap naming manok!

active_assignments.source_text: Siguradong mabubusog ka dito, promise!

localization.english: You'll definitely leave full, promise!
localization.tagalog: Sigurado, mabubusog ka dito, promise!

active_assignments.source_text: VIC SOTTO?!?!

localization.english: VIC SOTTO?!?!
localization.tagalog: VIC SOTTO?!?!

active_assignments.source_text: Kung [b]manok[/b] hanap mo, nasa tabi lang ng [b]Botika[/b] ang [b]Go To Chooks[/b].

localization.english: If you are looking for [b]chicken[/b], [b]Go To Chooks[/b] is right next to the [b]pharmacy[/b].
localization.tagalog: Kung [b]manok[/b] hanap mo, nasa tabi lang ng [b]Botika[/b] ang [b]Go To Chooks[/b].

active_assignments.source_text: Naamoy mo na bago mo makita. Effective signage din pala ang gutom.

localization.english: You smell it before you see it. Hunger really does make effective signage.
localization.tagalog: Naamoy mo na bago mo makita. Effective signage din pala ang gutom.

active_assignments.source_text: Bili na kayo, at magsasara na ako. Halos naubos na lahat ni Kapitan ang mga [b]supplies[/b].

localization.english: Buy now, I'm closing soon. The Captain just about cleaned out all the [b]supplies[/b].
localization.tagalog: Bili na kayo, magsasara na ko. Halos naubos na ni Kapitan lahat ng [b]supplies[/b].

active_assignments.source_text: Ikaw ulit?!!

localization.english: You again?!
localization.tagalog: Ikaw na naman?!

active_assignments.source_text: Pero i-check mo sa una unahan baka ay mayroon pa tira-tirang [b]plywood[/b] doon.

localization.english: But check up front, there might still be some [b]plywood[/b] left over.
localization.tagalog: Pero i-check mo sa unahan, baka may tira pang [b]plywood[/b] dun.

active_assignments.source_text: Lahat naghahanap ng [b]pako[/b] ngayon. Parang exam, pero [b]bubong[/b] ang reviewer.

localization.english: Everyone is looking for [b]nails[/b] now. It is like an exam, but the [b]roof[/b] is the reviewer.
localization.tagalog: Lahat naghahanap ng [b]pako[/b] ngayon. Parang exam, pero [b]bubong[/b] ang reviewer.

active_assignments.source_text: Kung may [b]martilyo[/b] ka, ingatan mo. Kapag nawala 'yan, gastos na naman.

localization.english: If you have a [b]hammer[/b], take care of it. Losing it would mean another expense.
localization.tagalog: Kung may [b]martilyo[/b] ka, ingatan mo. Kapag nawala 'yan, gastos na naman.

active_assignments.source_text: Utos lang ni Kapitan. Sabi niya bilhin ko lahat ng [b]pako[/b], [b]tarp[/b], [b]plywood[/b]... lahat daw kailangan sa barangay.

localization.english: Captain's orders. He told me to buy all the [b]nails[/b], [b]tarps[/b], [b]plywood[/b]... everything the barangay needs.
localization.tagalog: Utos lang ni Kapitan. Bilhin ko daw lahat ng [b]pako[/b], [b]tarp[/b], [b]plywood[/b]... lahat ng kailangan sa barangay.

active_assignments.source_text: Hindi ko na tinanong kung bakit sa bodega niya muna dadalhin. Trabaho lang, iho.

localization.english: I didn't ask why he's taking it to his storage room first. Just doing my job, iho.
localization.tagalog: Di ko na tinanong kung bakit sa bodega niya muna dadalhin. Trabaho lang, iho.

active_assignments.source_text: Oh, ano mga kailangan mo? Bilis, may bagyo na paparating at magsasara na ang [b]grocery[/b].

localization.english: So, what do you need? Hurry up, the storm's coming and the [b]grocery[/b]'s closing.
localization.tagalog: Oh, ano'ng kailangan mo? Dalian mo, may bagyo na at magsasara na ang [b]grocery[/b].

active_assignments.source_text: Ate Linda?? Nagtatrabaho karin pala sa hardware? Paano ka po nakarating dito?!

localization.english: Ate Linda?? You work at the hardware store too? How'd you even get here?!
localization.tagalog: Ate Linda?? Dito ka rin pala nagtatrabaho sa hardware? Pa'no ka po napunta dito?!

active_assignments.source_text: Sinong Ate Linda?! kita mo nag tatrabaho ako dito!

localization.english: Who's Ate Linda?! Can't you see I work here?!
localization.tagalog: Sinong Ate Linda?! Hindi ba obvious? Dito ako nagtatrabaho!

active_assignments.source_text: Kanina pa ako nakapila. Yung iba, doble-doble ang binibili.

localization.english: I've been standing in line forever. Some people are buying double.
localization.tagalog: Kanina pa ko nakapila. Yung iba, doble-doble ang binibili.

active_assignments.source_text: Kung kukuha ka ng [b]de lata[/b], kumuha ka lang ng [b]kaya mong dalhin[/b]. May kasunod ka pa.

localization.english: If you're getting [b]canned goods[/b], only take [b]what you can carry[/b]. There's people behind you.
localization.tagalog: Pag kukuha ka ng [b]de lata[/b], yung [b]kaya mo lang dalhin[/b]. May kasunod ka pa.

active_assignments.source_text: Kailangan ko pa ng lima... hindi, sampu! Paano kung isang linggo walang kuryente?

localization.english: I need five more... no, ten! What if the power's out for a week?
localization.tagalog: Kailangan ko pa ng lima... hindi, sampu! Paano kung isang linggong walang kuryente?

active_assignments.source_text: Wait, may budget pa ba ako? Ayoko tingnan.

localization.english: Wait, do I still have enough budget? I don't want to check.
localization.tagalog: Wait, may budget pa ba ako? Ayoko tingnan.

active_assignments.source_text: Basa na sapatos ko, pero kailangan pa rin pumila. May bata akong naghihintay sa bahay.

localization.english: My shoes are soaked, but I still have to stay in line. I've got a kid waiting at home.
localization.tagalog: Basa na sapatos ko, pero kailangan ko pa ring pumila. May batang naghihintay sa bahay.

active_assignments.source_text: Kapag may nakuha kang extra, isipin mo rin kung sino pa ang wala.

localization.english: If you get anything extra, think about who still has none.
localization.tagalog: Pag may nakuha kang extra, isipin mo rin kung sino pa ang wala.

active_assignments.source_text: Pasensya na. Kulang pamasahe ko pauwi. May maiaabot ka bang konti?

localization.english: Sorry. I'm short on fare to get home. Could you spare a little?
localization.tagalog: Pasensya na po. Kulang pamasahe ko pauwi. Pwede bang makahingi ng konti?

active_assignments.source_text: Salamat. Hindi ko makakalimutan 'to.

localization.english: Thank you. I won't forget this.
localization.tagalog: Salamat. Hindi ko makakalimutan 'to.
